name: Wirken: gateway started with no wirken update record on this host
message:
A Wirken gateway started on a host with no binary_installed row.

Detection: binary_changed_outside_update (12), informational
Severity baseline: informational

Installs through install.sh and source builds leave no binary_installed row, so this is not evidence of tampering; it marks a host whose binary cannot be checked against an install record. Pivot on host, @wirken.detail.version, @wirken.detail.commit, @wirken.detail.dirty.

Requires audit schema 2.3.0 and the @install.* pipeline attributes (see datadog/README.md).
